title: Drop
_lang: "en" or "fr"; leave empty to follow each browser
_users_file: where accounts are stored. Must be on a mount, or they vanish on the next rebuild. Defaults to /var/lib/depot-gw/users.json
_users: seed only: copied into users_file on first start, then managed from the interface. Hash with: depot-gw -hash 'the-password'
_root: empty root = the whole drop; set = confined to that subfolder
